notes: Landscape sheet, full source 2373 × 1690 pixels; half a is left, half b is right with overlap. The source files were viewed in whole/a/b order once each.

The visible front consists of handwritten mathematical fragments and six principal drawings; no prose title, date, manuscript folio or marginal prose is visible. The bottom-left 3 is retained as an archive-number comment, not as a manuscript page macro.

Faint reverse-side marks show through. No complete readable typed passage can be established from the authorized views. H editorial assertion of a typed verso is not adopted as source evidence, and no missing words are reconstructed.

The upper fragments involve Ob, Fl and Fl_0 and products of indexed C objects. Later lines use F_3 and F_n, inclusions O_i in F_i, a product ending literally (- ?), a row of starred pairs, and an amalgamation-like construction involving F × I.
The page contains no written proof. No proof, independent re-proof or formal mathematical check was performed; mathematical context was used only to flag locations for visual attention.

Possible intended multiplication at the two wedge-shaped signs, possible intended equality after F_n, and an expected uniform pair-index sequence are not substituted for the visible writing. These are possible author pen slips or unfinished notation, not established errors.
The author’s explicit question is the literal question mark in (- ?). There are no verbal author doubts to quote.

The raised mark on the large composite F is hat-like; the small subscript composite has a dot-like oblique speck. The uncertainty is marked at its first large occurrence and subsequent large occurrence follows that first candidate.

Several faint detached points and ticks are preserved geometrically without assigning an algebraic role. The long top arrow is certainly right-facing; an older cancelled left arrow is not securely established.

C geometry was reused where it matched the source. H actual drawing was checked, including its regularized grid, filled corner nodes, simplified cylinder, and lower grid junctions. Its editorial partial-status notice was not counted as a local doubt mark.

Completed one final text-only comparison against C; every substantive change is represented in an issue. A subsequent formatting-only control-space cleanup changes no reading. JSON structure and brace counts were checked; no compilation occurred.
